coordinate_convention: Godot: +Y up, -Z north. position_xyz is logical bounding-box CENTER. Full table h=1.80; physical support surface is at 1.00 above base.

recipe.eligibility: flat_proxy_fit AND unlocked AND capture_height AND unclaimed; min_tier gate disabled by default
recipe.success_milestone: Consume at least one landmark; continue to timeout or full clear. Score on completion only; 1134 total, no synthetic whole-assembly bonus. Diameter capped at 6.8 after growth 1000.
recipe.support_policy: Payload remains locked while root support is present. Capture root; detach existing descendants preserving IDs and world transforms; become separately capturable after entering the ground capture band. No new reward units are spawned.
recipe.geometry_note: Flat span = footprint diagonal for box proxies, diameter for sphere/cylinder proxies. Eligibility is NOT full-footprint coverage at the current offset; pull eligible targets inward before sinking. Use swept capture query to avoid frame-rate-dependent misses.

map.scenery_policy: BG outside playable land, NEVER in gameplay ledger
map.note: Concept perspective translated into coherent planar blockout, not an exact camera reconstruction.
